faqs.question: How do I book a bus ticket on VILS BUS.COM?
faqs.answer: Simply enter your departure city, destination, and travel date on the homepage. Browse available buses, select your preferred seats, enter passenger details, choose boarding/dropping points, and proceed to our secure mock checkout.

faqs.question: How long are my selected seats reserved during checkout?
faqs.answer: When you select seats on VILS BUS.COM, our backend server places a 10-minute temporary seat hold to ensure nobody else books them while you complete payment. If payment isn't completed within 10 minutes, the hold expires automatically.

faqs.question: What is the cancellation and refund policy?
faqs.answer: You can cancel confirmed tickets from 'My Bookings'. Cancellation > 24 hours prior to departure gives a 90% refund; 12–24 hours gives a 75% refund; 4–12 hours gives a 50% refund. Cancellations under 4 hours are non-refundable.

faqs.question: What payment methods are supported?
faqs.answer: In development mode, VILS BUS.COM features an interactive mock payment simulator supporting UPI / QR Code, Credit & Debit Cards, Net Banking, and Mobile Wallets. No actual money is transferred.

faqs.question: Are there dedicated seats for solo female travelers?
faqs.answer: Yes, VILS BUS.COM features pink-tinted 'Ladies Reserved' seats in both lower and upper decks. Adjacent berths to female travelers are reserved exclusively for women.
